description: Amends Rosewood Concept Plan to add a local road and a lane.
Allows street townhouses and other low-density residential uses.

chips.text: Notice sent to property owners within 150 meters of Rosewood Parcel V.
No public correspondence or presentations received on this amendment.

description: Approves a daycare for 40 children, 5 staff at 2610 14th Street East.
Requires relocating two power poles for on-site parking.

chips.text: Councillor Ford raised safety concerns about rear lane traffic, visibility, and snow maintenance.
Greystone Heights residents affected by increased traffic and parking in rear lane.
Daycare's weekend operating hours remained unknown during the discussion.
Public supported daycare but raised concerns about rear lane use, parking, and traffic.

description: Amends public notice policy, effective January 1, 2026.
Revises procedures for Council resolutions of support.
Proposes redesignating a buffer strip in Aspen Ridge.
Sell buffer to National Affordable Housing Corporation for $250.
Allows driveway access to their adjacent property.

chips.text: No public delegations spoke on the proposed redesignation.

description: Proposes new development application fees for 2026 and 2027.

chips.text: Applicants for development permits will pay new fees.
No public presentations were made on the proposed bylaw.
